scientific_goal: Predict expected full-cold GF2 vs strongest verified external SAT solver runtime using only source CNF structural features and R1-R3 prior results; route to GF2 only on sufficiently supported, lower-risk structural cohorts, otherwise fall back to unmodified CNF.

training_policy.samples: 13 DISTINCT ORIGINAL SHA sources from R1(3) R2(4) R3(6), with repeat and host medians aggregated once per source; not 3x the host repeats as independent data.
training_policy.feature_extraction: Before any solver, compute n, clause count, literal count, histogram of clause lengths, certified XOR-equation count, XOR support width histogram, degree distribution, support overlap and density, RHS balance and topology signature. No GF2 elimination, SAT solve, planted label, future timing or external holdout access.
training_policy.report_label: Observed log(median full cold GF2 / minimum median of 3/3 verified independent CryptoMiniSat native/original or CaDiCaL). Each CPU-censored baseline is missing, NEVER treated as completed.
training_policy.pinned_model: Deterministic bounded k-nearest-neighbor predictor over normalized logged structural features; one vote per original SHA and one aggregate per equivalent support topology/side. Fit only on historical completed validated observations.
training_policy.counterfactual_regret: Include empirical disagreement and leave-one-grid-size-out prediction error in safety margin; if too few independent support sizes, uncertain class or estimated speedup lower bound <1.20, abstain.
training_policy.out_of_domain: No training sources outside exact grid-family; all synthetic random-XOR and partial/mixed CNFs route to plain CryptoMiniSat without GF2, unless independently supported by future externally validated data. This is an explicit abstention, NOT a proof of generality.
training_policy.timeout_or_child_failure: Never use as a numerical speedup or positive training label.
training_policy.sparse_feature_computation_cap: <=160000 original literals, <=35000 clauses, <=2500 vars, max clause width<=6, bounded 2 seconds for feature extraction within full cold measurement.

rules.source_generator: Pure deterministic SHA-pinned generator R1 complete XOR Lights-out grid and R4 random planted parity/3SAT with random.Random seed, unique original CNF SHA; never reuse R1/R2/R3 samples.
rules.inputs_to_selector: Only original n and rows from CNF, no source ID, seed, expected SAT, solver output or run timing.
rules.selector_behavior: IF incomplete full XOR coverage OR out-of-distribution topology OR risky prediction THEN CryptoMiniSat on unchanged original CNF. IF exact XOR and sufficiently certain lower-bound predicted speedup >1.20 THEN standalone certified GF2, replay original CNF. The decision and estimated GF2/baseline cold time are recorded in the SAT receipt.
rules.negative_controls: Remove one parity clause; polarity permutation that breaks grid support must no longer be called Lights-out; random exact-XOR but non-grid should abstain; normal planted 3SAT should abstain; no C023 or E12C4 writes.
rules.signed_time: Parent-measured full cold subprocess wall includes Python startup, CNF generation, structural profiling, exact-cover inspection, decision, solver startup, original CNF replay and JSON serialization; separately report profiling wall.
rules.max_workers: 2 GitHub-hosted standard Ubuntu jobs; no paid/owner PC/NAS.
rules.arm_comparison: Do NOT include janus_gf2_exact_ablation as external comparator to itself.

frozen_science_gate.per_source: SAT solution for 3/3 selector trials verified on every original CNF clause on both hosts; fastest external completed 3/3 comparator must exist for finite speedup; timeout/censor -> abstention evidence, not numerical win.
frozen_science_gate.narrow_gain: At least 2 DISTINCT previously unmeasured grid sizes have >=1.20x selector speedup versus fastest verified external comparator on BOTH hosts, and every other tested source has <=10% time regret (>=1/1.10), WITH ALL selected solutions verified 3/3.
frozen_science_gate.abstention_proof: All 4 non-grid or incomplete-XOR tasks must choose original CNF CryptoMiniSat; source alterations cannot produce fake complete XOR.
frozen_science_gate.strong_all_controls_gate: All 3 external arms must verify SAT 3/3 on all cases; censored -> NOT PASSED even if narrow gain works.
frozen_science_gate.anti_overfit: All feature choices, fit source SHAs, model hyperparameters and threshold frozen before any R4 result. No tuning on R4 until a separate future R5 prereg cohort.
frozen_science_gate.honest_ceiling: Even a narrow win is not universal 3SAT/P=NP or external independently administered blinded verification; Stage5 general-purpose remains CLOSED.

external_witness_protocol.future_requirement: Third-party administrator controls unseen CNF set/labels and random seeds, sends only source constraints under agreed prereg and verifies solver artifacts independently. Independent provider+admin, signed SHA/source provenance, no access to our learned source SHA before freeze, read-only witness audit, never an own GitHub Actions worker called external.
